cases.case_label: ~130-bp Alu fragment inserted at an ABCD1 deletion breakpoint
cases.mechanism_detail: An intragenic ABCD1 deletion with Alu repeats at both breakpoints carried an additional inserted ~130-bp Alu fragment; the authors interpret it as a complex non-allelic homologous recombination event rather than clear retrotransposition.
cases.quote: At both breakpoints of an ALD deletion, Alu repeats have been found and, additionally, a short Alu region of approximately 130 bp was inserted
